riverbank-details.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game shoreline decoration atlas. Reference image supplies exact desired stone/reed style, camera and lighting. Generate one transparent atlas arranged as THREE columns by TWO rows, six clearly separate isolated horizontal shoreline clusters, all on actual transparent background. Three-quarter overhead miniature perspective, softly modeled volume, warm upper-left light and subtle contact shadows. Top row: predominantly pebbles and small rounded stones; bottom row: stones with a few thin green rushes. Each cluster roughly 4 times wider than tall, irregular edge and spaced stones with alpha gaps, stone sizes varied; no soil plate, no water, no solid strip, no rectangular base, no halo, no backdrop. Six variations form naturally broken riverbank dressing at a game tile width of 48 px; largest stones 5-8 game pixels high, reeds 8-12 game pixels. Consistent scale and lighting across cells, centered within equal cells with generous transparent spacing, no elements touching other cells. Avoid text labels, UI, characters, buildings, huge boulders, flowers, uniform rows and vector circles. Match the beautiful visible river stones and small shoreline vegetation in the reference, not photographic gravel.
